mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the left drive was most worthwhile because the assembly became recognizable as a rover.

leastWorthwhile.text: The later fittings felt repetitive because each result simply said “Created: Rover” without describing the addition.

surprise.text: The deck was named a rover as soon as the first drive was fitted, before the remaining parts were added.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the goals clearly identified each fitting, although the prescribed left-before-right order was not explained.

continue.text: I would probably not continue personally: the clear assembly steps were easy to follow, but the repeated results gave too little physical detail to keep me curious.
